Fixtures in this directory are font subsets, committed because the tests read
them with `include_bytes!` and so the crate will not compile without them.

DejaVuSans-subset.ttf
---------------------
Subset of DejaVu Sans, which is released under the Bitstream Vera Fonts
Copyright and the DejaVu Fonts License — both permissive, both permitting
redistribution including in binary form. Upstream:
https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html
Source on this machine:
/usr/local/texlive/2026/texmf-dist/fonts/truetype/public/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf

Cabin-subset.otf
----------------
Subset of Cabin Regular, released under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which
permits redistribution. Upstream: https://scripts.sil.org/OFL
Source on this machine:
/usr/local/texlive/2026/texmf-dist/fonts/opentype/impallari/cabin/Cabin-Regular.otf

Both were reduced with `fontTools.subset` to the glyphs the tests exercise, so
each is a few kilobytes rather than the full face. No other modification was
made: the outlines, encodings, and metrics the tests assert against are the
fonts' own.
